pilot_label: pilot_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt)

author_instructions.decision: set status to ACCEPTED or REJECTED, decided_by to your name and decided_on to the ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the decision; change nothing else
author_instructions.ACCEPTED: publication of pilot_002 results becomes allowed ONLY under the pilot label (pilot_label) and with every mandatory disclosure of the policy; the gate stays closed while any verifiable field differs from the current artifacts
author_instructions.REJECTED: publication stays refused; the measurements remain in the repository as verified but unaccepted results
author_instructions.PENDING: no decision yet; publication_allowed stays false

note: template prepared by the study closure; it is not a decision and carries status PENDING by construction - the closure never accepts
